H1: Reported political views will have an influence on a composite jealousy in relationships variable (jealousy about emotional infidelity, jealousy about sexual infidelity).
  IV: Political views 
  DV: Jealousy in relationships composite score 

H2: Reported financial prospects will have an influence on daily free time.
  IV: Financial prospects
  DV: Daily free time
  
```{r load data}

install.packages("psych")
library(psych)

getwd()
read.csv("Data/processed/h1.csv")
read.csv("Data/processed/h2.csv")

```
  
```{r histograms}

hist(h1$jealousy)
hist(h2$financialProspects)
hist(h2$freeTime)

```

```{r descriptive stats - jealousy}

# Mean
mean(h1$jealousy, na.rm = TRUE)

# Median
median(h1$jealousy, na.rm = TRUE)

# Range
range(h1$jealousy, na.rm = TRUE)

# IQR
IQR(h1$jealousy, na.rm = TRUE)

```

```{r descriptive stats - financial prospects}

# Mean
mean(h2$financialProspects, na.rm = TRUE)

# Median
median(h2$financialProspects, na.rm = TRUE)

# Range
range(h2$financialProspects, na.rm = TRUE)

# IQR
IQR(h2$financialProspects, na.rm = TRUE)

```

```{r descriptive stats - free time}

# Mean
mean(h2$freeTime, na.rm = TRUE)

# Median
median(h2$freeTime, na.rm = TRUE)

# Range
range(h2$freeTime, na.rm = TRUE)

# IQR
IQR(h2$freeTime, na.rm = TRUE)

```


```{r covariance and correlation}

#covariance
cov(h2$financialProspects, h2$freeTime, use = "complete.obs")

#correlation
cor(h2$financialProspects, h2$freeTime, use = "complete.obs")

```
